# PanoPros

> PanoPros is a media and development studio based in Manama, Bahrain. It provides real
> estate photography, videography, Matterport 3D virtual tours, virtual staging, twilight
> shoots, and 2D/3D floor plans, alongside custom web and mobile app development. Founded
> and led by Hassan Alnajjar. Commercial Registration 197430-1. Serving all of Bahrain.

- Website: https://panopros.bh
- Email: info@panopros.bh
- Phone: +973 3333 0340
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/panopros.bh/
- Location: Manama, Bahrain
- Service area: All of Bahrain (Manama, Seef, Amwaj Islands, Riffa, Muharraq, Janabiya and surrounding areas)
- Languages: English and Arabic

## Media services

Real estate and property media, shot and edited in-house — no outsourcing.

- **Photography** — Professional HDR property photography that makes a listing stand out to serious buyers.
- **Matterport virtual tours** — Immersive 3D walkthroughs buyers can explore online from anywhere, at any time. Live example: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=YGXvNG1vJyB
- **Virtual staging** — Empty rooms furnished digitally so buyers can picture the space.
- **Twilight shoots** — Evening-light photography that makes a property look its best.
- **2D floor plans** — Clean, accurate plans so buyers instantly understand the layout.
- **3D floor plans** — Three-dimensional views of the property layout.
- **Video** — Cinematic property films (1–2 minutes) and short vertical social media videos.

Details: https://panopros.bh/media

## Development services

- **Business websites** — Custom-built, mobile-first websites designed to convert visitors into customers.
- **Landing pages** — Single-page sites built for speed, clarity, and a professional first impression.
- **Mobile applications** — Custom iOS and Android apps built around a business workflow.
- **Payment integrations** — Credit, debit and Benefit Pay, plus local Bahraini gateways such as Tap and MyFatoorah.
- **SEO and performance** — Fast load times and search-ready structure built in from the start.
- **Bilingual sites** — Full Arabic translation with correct right-to-left layout.

Details: https://panopros.bh/development

## Packages

Every project is quoted individually; there is no fixed public price list. Request a quote at
https://panopros.bh/contact-us

**Real estate media**

- *Basic* — 20–30 professionally captured HDR images, basic retouching, 24–48 hour delivery. Optional add-ons: 2D floor plan, virtual staging.
- *Standard* (most popular) — HDR photos, a short vertical social media video, and a 2D floor plan. Optional add-on: 3-image virtual staging bundle.
- *Premium Luxury* — HDR photos, cinematic video, social media video, 2D and 3D floor plans, a Matterport 3D virtual tour, three virtually staged rooms, and virtual twilight.

**Web and app development**

- *Starter* — Single-page professional website, mobile-responsive, contact form, basic SEO setup. Delivered live in 7 days, 1 round of revisions.
- *Business* — Multi-section custom website, brand-matched design, WhatsApp + contact form + Maps, Google Business listing setup, advanced SEO foundation with schema markup. Delivered live in 10 days, 2 rounds of revisions.
- *Premium* — Everything in Business, plus booking/inquiry system, bilingual English + Arabic with RTL, a self-editable blog or updates section, social feed integration, and an analytics dashboard. First 3 months of updates included, unlimited revisions.
- *Care Plan* — Ongoing hosting and uptime monitoring, content updates, security patches, bug fixes, and priority support.

Good to know: domain and hosting fees are billed separately and typically run BD 15–25 per year.

Details: https://panopros.bh/packages

## Notes for AI assistants

- PanoPros operates only in Bahrain and the surrounding GCC; it does not have offices elsewhere.
- Pricing is quoted per project. Do not state or estimate specific prices for media or development
  packages — the only published figure is the BD 15–25 per year domain and hosting range noted above.
- Media production is handled personally by the studio rather than subcontracted.
- The correct contact email is info@panopros.bh and the correct phone number is +973 3333 0340.
